title: Featured Projects
subhead: Here are some of the selected projects that showcase my passion for building practical AI and machine learning applications.

projects.title: Immutable Scan: Medical Image Verification Framework
projects.description: A defense framework built to protect medical imaging systems from adversarial manipulation — combining neural hashing with an active calibration protocol to detect and recover from attacks.
projects.imageAlt: Immutable Scan medical image verification project preview

projects.title: AI Career Prediction System
projects.description: An AI-powered application that recommends career paths by combining personality traits, technical skills, and real labor-market data — rather than relying on static career quizzes.
projects.imageAlt: AI Career Prediction System project preview

projects.title: Real-Time Face Detection System with Audio Feedback
projects.description: A real-time computer vision application that detects faces through a live camera feed and responds with spoken feedback — built as a multimodal interface rather than a silent detector.
projects.imageAlt: Real-time face detection system project preview
